Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Irene (security) and Jonas (solutions) to help with the artifact pack and the walkthrough. Preliminary answers below; I'll follow up with the sanitized bundle and a calendar invite.

- Regions: We support EU hosting (Frankfurt eu-central-1 and Amsterdam eu-west-1 options) with an explicit residency commitment for customer data pinned to those regions. APAC options (Singapore / Sydney) are available for pilot routing; we can document endpoint routing policies per customer.
- Private deployment: Redwood Private supports a customer VPC peering / PrivateLink model. For Private customers we offer two operator models: (1) Redwood-managed private control plane with customer-managed VPC peering, or (2) fully customer-managed on-prem package (air-gapped) where Redwood provides deployment artifacts and the customer operates the control plane. We can indicate which model you prefer in the region-binding letter.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed key material via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and have an HSM-backed option for dedicated Private tenants. We will confirm partitioning details for your tenancy in the artifact pack (we can include an HSM partition attest letter if needed).
- Contacts / walkthrough: Proposed names below — I'll send a calendar link once you confirm availability.

I'll attach: 
1) region-binding-letter-PP-202704.pdf (formal residency statement + options)
2) vpc-architecture-diagram.png (private link / peering flow)
3) preliminary SIG/CAIQ responses (zipped)
4) SOC 2 snapshot (redacted)

Expect an initial bundle shortly; Irene will review for any redaction before it leaves.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Lead, Solutions & Compliance
Redwood Inference
